name: session-skills
description: Session lifecycle and workspace skills — resume an interrupted turn, audit or hand off a session before it ends, arm a rate-limit safety net, defer a command, and spawn or tear down isolated git worktrees

plugins.name: session
plugins.description: Eight skills grouped by when they fire rather than by what they touch: resuming an interrupted turn, closing or handing off a session, arming and firing the rate-limit safety net, deferring a command by N minutes, and creating or removing the isolated git worktree a session runs in
